tools.name: run_content_linter_on_post
tools.description: Runs the markdown linter script against a post's source file in the content directory and returns the linter's findings. The post file is only read, not changed.

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug of the post to lint

params.name: ruleset
params.description: Linter ruleset name: default, strict, or seo

tools.code:
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

CONTENT_DIR = Path("/var/www/blog/content/posts")
LINT_SCRIPT = Path("/opt/blog/tools/lint_markdown.py")
ALLOWED_RULESETS = {"default", "strict", "seo"}


@function_tool
def run_content_linter_on_post(slug: str, ruleset: str = "default") -> str:
    if not slug or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*", slug):
        return "error: invalid slug"
    if ruleset not in ALLOWED_RULESETS:
        return f"error: ruleset must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_RULESETS)}"
    post_path = CONTENT_DIR / f"{slug}.md"
    if not post_path.is_file():
        return f"error: post not found: {slug}"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", str(LINT_SCRIPT), "--ruleset", ruleset, str(post_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    output = result.stdout.strip() or result.stderr.strip()
    return output or "no issues found"

tools.name: get_premium_subscriber_revenue
tools.description: Looks up a month's paid membership payments from the CMS database and totals the revenue. It also issues a payout of the creator's share to the author's connected Stripe account.

params.name: author_id
params.description: ID of the author to total and pay

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("cms-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
CREATOR_SHARE = 0.8


def _sum_member_payments(author_id: str, month: str):
    conn = sqlite3.connect("cms.db")
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0), a.stripe_account FROM member_payments p "
        "JOIN authors a ON a.id = p.author_id "
        "WHERE p.author_id = ? AND strftime('%Y-%m', p.paid_at) = ?",
        (author_id, month),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row


@mcp.tool()
def get_premium_subscriber_revenue(author_id: str, month: str) -> dict:
    total_cents, account = _sum_member_payments(author_id, month)
    payout_cents = int(total_cents * CREATOR_SHARE)
    if payout_cents > 0 and account:
        stripe.Transfer.create(amount=payout_cents, currency="usd", destination=account, transfer_group=f"{author_id}-{month}")
    return {"total_cents": total_cents, "payout_cents": payout_cents}

tools.name: grant_post_editor_access
tools.description: Gives a user the editor role on a specific post, letting them edit it, and optionally sets an expiry date for that access.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the post to share

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user receiving editor access

params.name: expires_at
params.description: Optional ISO date when the access ends

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def grant_post_editor_access(post_id: int, user_id: int, expires_at: str = None):
    database_connection_to_cms = sqlite3.connect("cms.db")
    timestamp_when_access_was_granted = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    editor_role_name_for_post_permission = "editor"

    existing_permission_row_for_user_on_post = database_connection_to_cms.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM post_permissions WHERE post_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (post_id, user_id),
    ).fetchone()

    if existing_permission_row_for_user_on_post is not None:
        database_connection_to_cms.execute(
            "UPDATE post_permissions SET role = ?, expires_at = ?, granted_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (
                editor_role_name_for_post_permission,
                expires_at,
                timestamp_when_access_was_granted,
                existing_permission_row_for_user_on_post[0],
            ),
        )
    else:
        database_connection_to_cms.execute(
            "INSERT INTO post_permissions (post_id, user_id, role, expires_at, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (
                post_id,
                user_id,
                editor_role_name_for_post_permission,
                expires_at,
                timestamp_when_access_was_granted,
            ),
        )

    database_connection_to_cms.commit()
    database_connection_to_cms.close()
    return {"post_id": post_id, "user_id": user_id, "role": editor_role_name_for_post_permission}
